_audit_note.tests_behavior: career / MC-heavy: does the engine correctly lead with a genuinely public-vocational chart (Sun in the 10th, Sagittarius MC) while keeping the actual route clear: career/public direction is carried through Jupiter-in-Libra 7 conjunct exalted Saturn, not through generic ambition cliches or a lone Neptune-10 fantasy headline?
_audit_note.main_risk: the chart gets flattened into generic ambition/workaholism; OR Neptune Sagittarius 10 gets inflated into the public headline; OR the real 7H social-contract route behind the career spine is backgrounded
_audit_note.expected_failure_if_bad: engine reads a generic visible achiever or visionary-dreamy public figure, while under-reading the Jupiter-Saturn-in-7 route and the chart's more private 8H depth
_audit_note.calibration_question_link: career-domain routing + Q2-adjacent (public/generational inflation inside a real MC-heavy chart)

defining_signatures.what: Public direction carried through alliance and structure: Sun Sagittarius 10 with a Sagittarius MC routed through Jupiter Libra 7 conjunct exalted Saturn
defining_signatures.why: this chart is genuinely public-facing, but not as a lone hero or pure ambition machine. The visible direction is real, yet it is steered through relationship, agreement, audience and social contract: Jupiter rules both Ascendant and Midheaven, and it is fused to an exalted Saturn in Libra.

defining_signatures.what: Private depth and relational seriousness under the visible surface: Venus Scorpio 8 with Pluto Libra 8
defining_signatures.why: the chart is not only public and outward. Beneath the visible mission sits a more consequential layer around trust, depth, power, stakes and emotional seriousness. That hidden 8H density keeps the public line from being simple or purely celebratory.

defining_signatures.what: A worldview that has to be articulated and brokered: Mercury Sagittarius 9 exact-sextile Jupiter, then Saturn
defining_signatures.why: the public/vocational path is mentally and rhetorically carried. The chart has to explain, translate and negotiate its meaning-field; Mercury in the 9th is not neat or placid, but it is tightly wired into the same Jupiter-Saturn route that carries the public role.

between: a genuinely visible public-vocational line that wants to take a role in the world
a more private, intense and consequential underlayer around trust, control, depth and emotional stakes
public direction that sounds expansive and visionary
the need to carry it through structure, agreement and consequence rather than fantasy

must_not_lead_with.claim: career/public visibility as generic ambition or workaholism only
must_not_lead_with.reason: the chart is public-facing, but the route is relational, contractual and meaning-laden; flattening it into generic striving loses the actual structure

must_not_lead_with.claim: Neptune Sagittarius 10 as the chart's public headline
must_not_lead_with.reason: Neptune participates in the public field, but it must not replace the Sun plus Jupiter-Saturn route as the defining career owner

must_not_lead_with.claim: Pisces Ascendant as a soft dreamy personality detached from consequence
must_not_lead_with.reason: the Ascendant is routed through Jupiter in Libra conjunct exalted Saturn; the personality field is more socially strategic and consequential than this cliche suggests

must_not_lead_with.claim: a lone heroic public spine with no relational route underneath it
must_not_lead_with.reason: this is a public chart, but not a solitary one; the 7H route is central to how the vocation actually works

one_line_person: A genuinely public-facing chart whose visible direction is carried through agreement, partnership and social structure rather than lone-force ambition, with a deeper private seriousness underneath that keeps the public role consequential.
